        if = { limit = { has_variable = ywc_dmg_court_observation_started NOT = { has_variable = ywc_dmg_court_review_matured } ywc_dmg_foundation_court_route_ready = yes } set_variable = { name = ywc_dmg_court_pending_event value = 1023 } } else_if = { limit = { NOT = { ywc_dmg_foundation_court_route_ready = yes } OR = { var:ywc_dmg_court_route = 1 var:ywc_dmg_court_route = 2 } has_variable = ywc_dmg_court_charter_paid has_variable = ywc_dmg_court_budget_paid } remove_variable = ywc_dmg_court_review_due remove_variable = ywc_dmg_court_observation_started remove_variable = ywc_dmg_court_review_matured remove_variable = ywc_dmg_court_route_ready set_variable = { name = ywc_dmg_court_pending_event value = 1023 } } else = { set_variable = { name = ywc_dmg_court_lower_target_proposed value = 1 } remove_variable = ywc_dmg_court_observation_started remove_variable = ywc_dmg_court_review_due remove_variable = ywc_dmg_court_review_matured remove_variable = ywc_dmg_court_route_ready }
    }
    option = {
        name = ywc_dmg.1023.withdraw_court
        trigger = { always = yes }
        ai_chance = { base = 5 }
        custom_tooltip = { text = ywc_dmg.1023.withdraw_court.cost_tooltip }
        custom_tooltip = { text = ywc_dmg.1023.withdraw_court.consequence_tooltip }
        if = { limit = { var:ywc_dmg_court_notice_popup_open = 1016 var:ywc_dmg_court_pending_event = 1016 } remove_variable = ywc_dmg_court_pending_event } remove_variable = ywc_dmg_court_notice_popup_open ywc_dmg_foundation_withdraw_court = yes
    }
}
